title: Hover at Cursor
summary: Shows a hover card for the symbol under the editor caret: signature, declared type, documentation, and callers
intro: Read this to check what a symbol is and who calls it without leaving the line you are on. With the caret on it choose drag-lint > Hover at Cursor (Ctrl+Alt+H); on the command line, hover --qname Foo.Bar gives the same card.

steps: Needs an index of the project
Put the editor caret on the symbol

questions.ask: What is the signature, documentation and callers of the symbol under my caret?
Can I get the hover card as markdown?
What type does a re-published property (property Text;) have, and which ancestor declares it?
questions.command: drag-lint hover --qname <Unit.TDerived.Text> --format json   (fields type + declared_in; --write-back memoizes the type into a writable index)
